item.title: TTT 388: Hot Tubbin'
item.description:
Both Rachelle and Eric agree that the measure of success is how many hot tubs you have. Just try and dispute us. You can’t.

We are Calgary’s only podcast.

Music

  • The Plimsouls - Playing With Jack
  • Nimmo and the Gauntletts - Jaded

item.title: TTT 386: Personal Opinions
item.description:
We have a lot of opinions — mostly dumb. We let our charm cover up our clear lack of authority on any given subject. Hear us cast opinions on “tasteful erotic nudes”, sororities, and smartphone apps. Calgary’s only podcast!

Music

  • Hightime Rebellion - Sail
  • Speak - Gates

item.title: TTT 376: Neighbourhood Watch
item.description:
Rachelle is spying on the neighbourhood because she suspects something is amiss. Eric pushes buttons - both figuratively and literally. A special guest joins us. Our guest has better microphone technique than Rachelle.

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: TTT 318: Top That!
item.description:
One way or another we’ll get another show out - even if it kills us. We discuss people in China who have figured out the secret ingredient to stamina pills, fifty shades of making babies, and the most dangerous item to be stopped at the US border. Listen! We are fun!

item.title: TTT 310: Close Calls With White Walls
item.description:
Guest Hosts: Joel, Keith

Joel and Keith from The Vinyl Countdown podcast fill in for us while we try and figure this baby thing. Both of these guys do their best work when they’re on a break from work. Check them out at vinylcountdown.ca
